title: Freight Delivery Receipt Form
subtitle: Reconcile the promised freight delivery with actual units, condition, custody, evidence, exceptions, receiving decision, and accountable handoff.
description: An original, fillable freight delivery receipt form for controlling palletized, crated, or unitized freight shipment through delivery receipt identity, observations, evidence, decision, exceptions, escalation, completion, handoff, and final verification without replacing applicable requirements or professional review.
use_case: Use at Consignee dock and delivery appointment when consignee receiving representative and the delivering custodian need one receipt that separates physical handoff from inspection, hold, commercial acceptance, and exception resolution.

sections.title: Freight delivery receipt identity and routing
sections.guidance: Anchor the record to the exact work, parties, locations, and source references.

sections.title: Freight delivery commitment and receiving readiness
sections.guidance: Confirm what was expected, where it was due, and which controls governed acceptance.

items: Keep dry

sections.title: Freight delivered-unit reconciliation
sections.guidance: Reconcile each delivered identity and quantity before relying on totals or signatures.

sections.title: Freight condition inspection and receipt evidence
sections.guidance: Preserve observations made before the receiver changes packaging, custody, or physical condition.

blocks.label: Freight receipt inspection
items: Shipment reference matches carrier document, purchase order, and packing list
Pallet, crate, and handling-unit count agrees with tendered quantity
Visible weight and dimension markings support the planned equipment
Pallet deck, crate panels, wrap, banding, and corner protection are intact
Labels remain readable and do not conflict across handling units
Seal number and trailer identity agree with dispatch records
Blocking, bracing, dunnage, and tiedowns appear suitable for the load configuration
No leakage, leaning, collapse, puncture, water exposure, or contamination is visible
Appointment, dock, liftgate, accessorial, and unloading needs are confirmed
A discrepancy is held for qualified review before tender, release, or disposition

blocks.label: Receipt evidence index
blocks.guidance: Record only necessary proof and preserve privacy or security restrictions.

blocks.label: Condition, count, custody, and acceptance narrative

fields.label: Condition, count, custody, and acceptance narrative

blocks.guidance: Describe facts that cannot be reconstructed from the line table or evidence reference.

sections.title: Freight exception, containment, and escalation
sections.guidance: Make the trigger, affected scope, immediate control, owner, deadline, and escalation reconstructable.

blocks.label: Freight exception indicators
items: Handling-unit or piece shortage, overage, or substitution
Visible crush, puncture, collapse, tilt, water, or contamination damage
Pallet, crate, wrap, banding, or securement is compromised
Trailer or seal identity differs from the shipment record
Weight, dimension, freight description, or equipment is inconsistent
Appointment is missed or consignee cannot unload
Freight is refused, partially accepted, or redirected
Temperature, food, hazardous, or special handling control is uncertain
Carrier document, purchase order, or packing list cannot be reconciled
Salvage, rework, return, or disposal instruction is unresolved
blocks.guidance: Select every observed condition; do not use a generic exception mark when the actual trigger is known.

blocks.label: Receipt hold, partial acceptance, refusal, or resolution

sections.title: Freight receipt decision and custody transfer
sections.guidance: Separate physical custody from final commercial, quality, safety, or financial acceptance.

blocks.label: Delivery and receiving attestation
blocks.guidance: Attestation confirms the recorded physical event, not waiver of a concealed issue or unresolved review.

sections.title: Freight delivery receipt closeout and accountable handoff
sections.guidance: Close only when outcome, remaining limitation, next action, evidence, and receiving ownership agree.

blocks.label: Final outcome, handoff, and record location
Record boundary and stop condition
blocks.guidance: Use this freight delivery receipt with the applicable customer commitment, carrier terms, site policy, and retention requirements. Do not infer acceptance or release from a signature alone; unresolved identity, count, condition, custody, or proof issues require an owner, escalation, and documented disposition.

blocks.label: Prepared, reviewed, and accepted

fields.label: Reviewed by shipping or receiving manager

blocks.guidance: A signature records accountability for the stated decision; it does not cure missing evidence or override a stop condition.
